title: Finalize PLG signal definitions, thresholds, and success metrics for NA pilot
creator: Nikhil Sharma
description:
## Context
We need a canonical v1 set of “sales-worthy” product-led signals (threshold + intent) with clear definitions, thresholds, time windows, and success metrics. This ticket is the Phase 0 deliverable required before Eng locks event contracts + daily aggregation and before HubSpot workflows are configured.

Primary consumers:
- AEs/SDRs: actionability + low noise
- SEs: clear “why now” context (performance/compliance)
- Growth/Marketing: suppression rules to avoid conflicting touches

Stakeholders consulted for v1:
- Jordan Blake (CRO), Stephanie Nguyen (VP Sales NA), Ben Carter (Growth)
- Logan Wright / Mei Lin (telemetry + aggregation feasibility)
- David Kim / Isabelle Laurent (HubSpot + ownership + CRM hygiene)
- Dr. Aisha Rahman / Marcus Lin (privacy/data handling)
- Markus Klein (SE routing criteria)

---

## Deliverable
1) Final list of v1 signals with:
- source events
- definition and threshold
- lookback window
- dedupe key
- routing tier (AE-only vs AE+SE vs security review)
- suppression guidance

2) Success metrics for the pilot (measured weekly):
- operational health metrics (volume, precision, lag)
- funnel outcomes (contacted, meeting booked, eval started, opp created)

---

## v1 Signal Taxonomy
### A) Threshold signals (scale / reliability / expansion)
Purpose: detect accounts hitting limits where Dedicated/Private materially helps.

### B) Intent signals (purchase / compliance / deployment interest)
Purpose: detect explicit “I’m evaluating Dedicated/Private” behavior.

Routing policy:
- Threshold-only signals should typically route at “medium confidence” unless reinforced by intent (to reduce spam).
- Intent signals can route at lower volume if they are high-intent (security docs, VPC/private docs).

---

## v1 Signals (Definitions + Thresholds)
NOTE: thresholds below are the agreed pilot cut lines for NA self-serve cohorts; they may be re-tuned after Week 1 and Week 2 reviews based on false positive rate and AE capacity.

### 1) Sustained token volume (Scale)
- Name: PLG_USAGE_SUSTAINED_TOKENS
- Definition: org has >= 15M output tokens in any rolling 7-day window OR >= 50M total tokens (input+output) in rolling 7-day window.
- Source: usage meters (tokens by org_id, model_family)
- Lookback: 7d rolling; aggregation daily
- Dedupe: (org_id, signal_type, window_end_date)
- Confidence: medium; becomes high if combined with Dedicated docs interest OR repeated 429s.
- Recommended motion: AE outreach (Dedicated intro + throughput planning); loop SE only if customer states latency/SLO sensitivity or asks for benchmarks.

Rationale: based on cohort distribution review (see pilot analysis sheet) and expected weekly volume manageable for NA AEs.

### 2) Spend velocity spike (Scale / budget readiness)
- Name: PLG_SPEND_VELOCITY
- Definition: >= $1,500 net spend in trailing 7 days AND >= 40% WoW increase (7d vs previous 7d).
- Source: billing events / invoice usage summaries
- Lookback: 14d (to compute WoW); aggregation daily
- Dedupe: (org_id, signal_type, window_end_date)
- Confidence: high if also has team expansion or repeated rate limits.
- Motion: AE outreach with “cost predictability + reserved capacity” angle; refer to upgrade triggers guidance.

Guardrail: ignore orgs with active “paid annual commit” already present in CRM (to avoid redundant outreach).

### 3) Repeated 429s / rate-limit pressure (Reliability)
- Name: PLG_RELIABILITY_429_PRESSURE
- Definition: >= 75 HTTP 429 responses/day for 3 distinct days within trailing 7 days OR >= 400 429s in trailing 7 days.
- Source: API gateway logs (status_code=429, org_id)
- Lookback: 7d; daily aggregation
- Dedupe: (org_id, signal_type, window_end_date)
- Confidence: high (actionable pain)
- Motion: AE + SE recommended (SE can propose batching/caching config; AE positions Dedicated burst / reserved throughput).

Suppression: if an AE task was created in last 10 days for this org for the same signal type, do not create a new task; instead append a single timeline note.

### 4) Elevated error rates (Reliability)
- Name: PLG_RELIABILITY_5XX_ERRORS
- Definition: 5xx rate >= 0.8% across trailing 24h AND at least 10k requests/day (avoid tiny-sample vanity).
- Source: API gateway logs
- Lookback: 24h; daily aggregation
- Dedupe: (org_id, signal_type, window_end_date)
- Confidence: medium; often product/support issues
- Motion: route to Support/CS first if known incident; otherwise AE note only (no task) until confirmed non-incident.

Decision: v1 will log this as a company property + timeline note but will not auto-create an AE task unless combined with spend velocity or sustained tokens.

### 5) Team expansion / multi-workspace growth (Expansion)
- Name: PLG_ORG_TEAM_EXPANSION
- Definition: any of:
  - >= 2 new workspaces created in trailing 14 days OR
  - >= 8 new user invites in trailing 7 days OR
  - first time org enables “multiple workspaces” (feature flag / settings event)
- Source: control-plane events (workspace_created, org_invite_sent, setting_changed)
- Lookback: 14d
- Dedupe: (org_id, signal_type, window_end_date)
- Confidence: medium
- Motion: AE outreach focused on rollout planning + centralized billing + governance; loop CS if existing customer.

Guardrail: if org is already in “CS owned / active contract” state, create a CS notification note (no outbound task) unless AE owner requests otherwise.

---

## Intent Signals (Definitions + Thresholds)
### 6) Dedicated docs interest (Purchase intent)
- Name: PLG_INTENT_DEDICATED_DOCS
- Definition: >= 2 sessions viewing Dedicated-related docs pages within trailing 7 days OR >= 3 total page views (unique page paths) in trailing 14 days.
- Source: docs instrumentation (page_view events; org_id when logged in; otherwise mapped via workspace domain when available)
- Lookback: 14d
- Dedupe: (org_id, signal_type, window_end_date)
- Confidence: medium; becomes high if paired with scale/reliability signals.
- Motion: AE task (lightweight) with “Dedicated overview + quick sizing call.”

### 7) Private/VPC docs interest (High intent / SE + security)
- Name: PLG_INTENT_PRIVATE_VPC
- Definition: any of:
  - views of Private/VPC/on-prem docs pages in trailing 7 days (>= 1 session) OR
  - views of “data residency” / “KMS/HSM” docs pages (>= 2 page views in trailing 14 days)
- Source: docs instrumentation
- Lookback: 14d
- Dedupe: (org_id, signal_type, window_end_date)
- Confidence: high
- Motion: AE + immediate SE involvement; flag security review path. Add checklist pointer to Security FAQ.

### 8) Security/compliance content intent (High intent)
- Name: PLG_INTENT_SECURITY_SALES
- Definition: >= 2 page views of Security FAQ / SOC2 / audit logs / retention pages within trailing 7 days OR download/click of SOC2 request CTA.
- Source: docs + marketing site events
- Lookback: 7d
- Dedupe: (org_id, signal_type, window_end_date)
- Confidence: high
- Motion: create AE task; include “offer security review call” snippet; tag for security team loop-in when requested.

Decision (privacy): we will NOT send raw page URLs or full clickstream into HubSpot; only send aggregated signal_type + counts + date range.

---

## Scoring + Qualification (v1)
We will keep scoring simple for v1 to reduce debate and accelerate shipping:
- Each signal has an intrinsic confidence (low/medium/high).
- “Qualified for task” rules:
  - Always task: PLG_RELIABILITY_429_PRESSURE, PLG_INTENT_PRIVATE_VPC, PLG_INTENT_SECURITY_SALES
  - Task if combined (any 2 within 14d): sustained tokens + dedicated docs; spend velocity + team expansion; sustained tokens + 429 pressure
  - Note-only (no task) unless combined: 5xx errors

Suppression rules (v1):
- Suppress same (org_id, signal_type) tasks for 10 days after creation.
- Global suppress window: if any AE task created for the org in last 5 days from this pipeline, do not create additional tasks; append note instead.
- Exclusions: internal/test orgs; known partners; employees.

Ownership/hand-off constraints (alignment with routing ADR):
- Preserve existing owner in HubSpot if present.
- If no owner: assign by region when available; else NA pilot round-robin list.
- If “CS owned / active contract”: notify CSM (note) and do not create net-new outbound unless flagged as expansion-ready by CS.

---

## Success Metrics (Pilot)
### Primary outcome metrics (leading indicators)
Measured weekly, NA pilot cohort only:
- Meeting booked rate: meetings_booked / qualified_tasks_created
  - Target: 12–18% by end of Week 4 (after tuning)
- Evaluation started rate: evals_started / meetings_booked
  - Target: 35%+
- Opp created rate: opps_created / meetings_booked
  - Target: 25%+

### Business outcome metrics (lagging)
- Dedicated/Private pipeline created ($) attributable to signal within 30 days
- Conversion rate to sales-assisted motion (self-serve -> sales-assisted) for signaled accounts vs control cohort

### Quality / hygiene metrics (must-haves)
- False positive rate (manually marked) <= 20% by end of Week 2
- AE capacity: avg qualified tasks per AE per week <= 12 (NA pilot)
- Dedupe correctness: no more than 1 task per org per signal_type per suppression window

### Operational metrics
- Pipeline lag: P95 < 12 hours from event to HubSpot update
- HubSpot API failure rate: < 0.5% daily; retries succeed within 24h

Exit criteria for v1 definition phase:
- Signals + thresholds documented and approved by Sales Ops + Security
- At least one sample company timeline note reviewed and deemed “not creepy” (privacy-safe)

---

## Privacy / Data Handling Decisions (captured for Eng + Security)
- Send to HubSpot: org_id->company mapping identifier, signal_type enum, counts (aggregated), window dates, last_seen timestamp, and a short reason string.
- Do NOT send: raw prompts, user-level identifiers, full URLs, query params, IP addresses, or fine-grained per-request logs.
- Retention: signal history in analytics dataset per data handling policy; HubSpot retains only the latest “last_signaled_at” + rolling summary fields where possible.

---

## Open Questions (tracked for Phase 2)
- Trial vs paid segmentation: should thresholds be lower for paid accounts? (Current v1: same thresholds; routing copy differs.)
- Industry compliance heuristic: do we add enrichment (healthcare/fintech) before routing? (Deferred; may be vendor/enrichment work.)
- In-product nudge: do we coordinate a banner/tooltip when 429 pressure is sustained? (Discussed; not in v1.)
